waters.name: Innsmouth Harbour
waters.line: The harbour smells of fish and something older.

waters.name: The Miskatonic, below Arkham
waters.line: Soggy pages drift past now and then.

waters.name: The Skai at Ulthar
waters.line: Alice and Siouxsie watch from the bank.

waters.name: Lawson Delta bayou
waters.line: Something big moves under the lily pads.

waters.name: Booty Bay, Stranglethorn Coast
waters.line: Pirates argue about a fishing contest on the pier.

waters.name: Devil Reef
waters.line: Black rocks just under the surface.

waters.name: Kingsport, in the fog
waters.line: You can't see the bobber. You can feel it.

waters.name: The Sky-Sea of Serannian
waters.line: Kuranes' galleys pass overhead. Your line hangs down into pink cloud.

waters.name: The Cove
waters.line: The tide pulls at your boots.

waters.name: The Fishing Hamlet
waters.line: Grant us eyes, the villagers whisper.

waters.name: The Sea of Ghosts
waters.line: Ice floes knock against the boat.

waters.name: The Cerenarian Sea
waters.line: The water is the colour of a dream you forgot.

waters.name: The Unterzee
waters.line: Zee-lights blink far out. The crew sings to keep their nerve.

waters.name: The Twisted Strand
waters.line: The roots in the water twist the wrong way.

waters.name: The Lost River
waters.line: Green brine glows far below.

waters.name: The Well on the Blasted Heath
waters.line: Everything down here glows a colour that isn't.

waters.name: The Lake of Hali
waters.line: Twin suns sink behind the towers.

waters.name: The Black Pool of N'kai
waters.line: A toad-shaped shadow sleeps beneath.

waters.name: The Devil's Roar
waters.line: The sea boils. Somebody's ship is on fire, again.

waters.name: The Inkwater of Apocrypha
waters.line: The pages under the ink turn by themselves.

waters.name: The lake beneath the Mountains of Madness
waters.line: Tekeli-li echoes off the ice.

waters.name: Y'ha-nthlei
waters.line: Lights move in the drowned city.

waters.name: Ny'alotha, the Waking City
waters.line: Something whispers that you will drown here.

waters.name: Sunken R'lyeh
waters.line: The angles of the water are all wrong.

waters.name: The shores of Yuggoth
waters.line: Fungal wings buzz overhead.

waters.name: The Sea of Stars around Azathoth's throne
waters.line: The pipers play. Don't listen.

fish.flavour: There's nothing inside it. Nothing at all.

The lake beneath the Mountains of Madness

fish.flavour: Rings faintly when it moves.

fish.name: Old Captain Obed

fish.flavour: Old as the reef. The reef calls it father.

ultras.name: Old Barnacle-Jaw
ultras.lore: The old fish of Innsmouth's harbour. Obed Marsh tried to hook it in 1846 and lost three fingers.
